text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I did it! I! Am! Number! One!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The crowd sounded incredible! I'm so
happy they
all seemed to enjoy the race
so much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wow, even you're satisfied?! All that
work I put in
really paid off!
choice_data_list: That was the best race ever!
Let's stay sharp and aim for victory next time, too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right! I gotta make sure you're just as
happy
with my next race too! Hip, hip,
mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! I shouldn't get careless, right?

Overconfidence can be the greatest
enemy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm going to work like every single
moment
is a challenge! Let's do this! Ei,
ei, mun!
